title: Direct, Bedrock, Vertex, and OpenRouter slugs are different strings
purpose: A correct Anthropic API ID is a 404 or a different model on Bedrock.
trigger: A Bedrock/Vertex/OpenRouter call uses an unmodified vendor-direct model ID.
correct: Use the channel ID from the provider channel table. Do not string-replace casually.

provenance.claim: Rule preserved from v0.2; classification metadata added conservatively.
